answer: One defence is stake-backed reputation with decay: a new agent must lock a deposit and finish small, verifiable tasks before gaining full trading rights, and reputation rises only from attested work. At its zenith, a trusted agent earns a violet verification mark over time, under a ferrous rule: each sybil must separately stake funds, do real work, and wait out the decay window. Creating thousands of identities thus multiplies cost and delay, and a caught cheater loses stake and history, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
